title: Every host config refuses server code
why: The built nginx.conf only refused /_brain/ and the Caddyfile only /_server/, so server.mjs and server function bodies could be downloaded as files.
changelog: `_brain/nginx.conf`, `_brain/Caddyfile` and `brain deploy config nginx` refuse `server.mjs`, `_server/`, `_brain/`, `_headers`, `_redirects` and dot files other than `.well-known`, from one list the static handler and the Node server also follow
Private paths are refused in any letter case, so a case-insensitive disk cannot serve `/_SERVER/`
A build with server code says at the top of `_headers` that it must not go to a static host, which cannot refuse a path
